ShieldAbility.create: Create the shield granted by this ability
ShieldAbility.bind: Designate an existing shield for this ability
ShieldAbility.melee: Attack with the shield in melee
ShieldAbility.paired: Main attack and extra Hidden Shield attack (both hindered)
ShieldAbility.RangeHint: For attacks, confirm melee reach or short throwing range. Target order is attack order; Bouncing Shield permits the third target to be the first target again.
ShieldAbility.RangeConfirmed: The targets are within the required range
ShieldAbility.EffectEffort: Spend one Effort level to hinder a hit target for one round
ShieldAbility.StaleCatch: The retained roll succeeded, but this catch's consequences can no longer be confirmed automatically. Check the shield's current location and any point-cost refund with the GM.
ShieldAbility.LandsImmediate: The shield is not in hand. After a failed catch, Bouncing Shield lands within immediate range. Retrieve it before using it again.
ShieldAbility.LandsShort: The shield is not in hand. After a failed catch, it most likely lands a short distance away. Retrieve it before using it again.
ShieldAbility.ResourcesConfirm: Confirm that the required resources and crafting skill or outside arrangements have been provided. Hidden Shield repair takes about one day; an Unyielding Shield replacement takes 1d6 days of concerted effort. The CRD gives no fixed resource price, so this requires adjudication.
ShieldAbility.WorkCompletedConfirm: Confirm that the required repair or replacement work has actually been completed. Its game-time deadline must also have elapsed.
ShieldAbility.WorkStarted: Shield work started: {days} day(s) of work required.
ShieldAbility.WorkReady: Work deadline elapsed; confirm completion through the ability control
ShieldAbility.TurnLossPending: Unyielding Shield survived a major wound. Your next turn is lost unless the GM chooses an intrusion instead. The combat tracker skips that turn automatically; outside combat, acknowledge the lost turn here.
ShieldAbility.ChooseIntrusion: GM: replace the lost turn with an intrusion
ShieldAbility.TurnLost: The next turn was lost because of Unyielding Shield.
ShieldAbility.IntrusionChosen: The GM chose an intrusion instead of the lost turn from Unyielding Shield. Resolve that intrusion with the GM.
ShieldAbility.InvalidUse: This shield operation is unavailable. Check ownership, designation, equipment state, targets, resources and the work deadline.
